projects.name: Dynamic Forms — EjeSatelital
projects.short_description: Dynamic forms module integrated into the EjeSatelital platform, with mobile response collection, chart visualization and report generation.
projects.problem_solved: The EjeSatelital platform needed a specialized dynamic forms module with mobile data collection, capable of integrating with its existing reporting modules and providing response visualization with charts.
projects.description: Developed and improved a dynamic forms module within the EjeSatelital platform, working on existing code alongside another developer in charge of the mobile app. I implemented the web panel and backend with dynamic form rendering, form creation and editing from the panel, API endpoints for response reception, data visualization with charts, evidence upload (images and signatures), PDF/Excel report generation, automated notifications, and integration with other internal platform modules.
engineering_challenges: Handling evidence files and signatures
Dynamic generation of structured reports

projects.name: Loss Calculator — AguaSiempre
projects.short_description: Interactive calculator that estimates livestock economic loss based on distance to watering points, with Leaflet maps and step-by-step workflow.
projects.problem_solved: Livestock operations needed to quantify the economic loss from cattle walking to watering points in order to evaluate investment in a per-parcel water system.
projects.description: Multi-step calculator built with pure HTML, CSS and JavaScript following Figma designs with AguaSiempre's distinctive branding. The workflow guides users from location selection and geofence drawing on a Leaflet map, through watering point placement and cattle routes, to automatic annual economic loss calculation and result conversion. Includes an integrated contact form at the end and automatic email notifications upon completion.
engineering_challenges: Complex multi-step logic in vanilla JavaScript
Responsive design and animations with pure CSS
Geospatial map interaction usability

projects.name: Medical Clinic Management
projects.short_description: Clinical management SaaS with chat, appointments, digital prescriptions and payment tracking. Functional before pretty.
projects.problem_solved: Existing clinic systems were either too expensive with unnecessary features, or too basic. An in-between solution was needed with exactly what a real clinic requires to operate.
projects.description: Full stack SaaS built on Whaticket (free version), adapted and extended for medical clinics. Covers the full cycle: doctor calendars with appointment management, real-time chat/tickets connected to WhatsApp and Twilio, patient medical history, digital prescription generator with templates (Craft.js), cash register and payment tracking, automatic reminders, and multi-company configuration. No visual frills, but all the functionality a small to mid-size clinic needs to run its operations.
engineering_challenges: Adapting Whaticket free, 4-5 year-old legacy code, to a completely different domain
Updating dependencies and compatibility with modern Node, React and TypeScript versions
Stability of whatsapp-web.js against frequent WhatsApp API changes
Prescription generator with variable templates using Craft.js
Real-time ticket and chat synchronization

projects.name: Diesel Control — Aspros
projects.short_description: Web dashboard and mobile app for digital control of agricultural diesel consumption, with GPS machinery tracking and tank-to-vehicle dispatch management.
projects.problem_solved: Agricultural operations lacked real visibility into diesel consumption per machine, activity, or zone. They needed to digitize fuel dispatch and track per-machine usage to detect inefficiencies and optimize costs.
projects.description: System composed of a web dashboard and mobile app that digitizes diesel control in agricultural operations. Dispatchers log fuel dispatching from tanks to machinery in the app. Operators start activities with continuous GPS tracking (offline-first) to calculate per-machine consumption and routes. The web dashboard allows management and accountants to view consumption reports, anomaly alerts, tank status and per-vehicle performance, with zone-based permissions and differentiated roles.
key_features: Fuel dispatch from tank to vehicle
engineering_challenges: Reliable GPS tracking in Android background mode
Offline-first synchronization consistency with local SQLite
Inventory reconciliation logic
Android 14/15 background restrictions
Real-time telemetry reliability
Geospatial visualization performance

projects.name: AI-Powered Job Portal
projects.short_description: Job portal with candidate profiles, job listings, talent hunting and AI analysis to streamline hiring.
projects.problem_solved: Companies and candidates needed a centralized recruitment process combining job management, talent hunting, psychometric evaluations and artificial intelligence to speed up selection, instead of relying on scattered tools like forms, email and spreadsheets.
projects.description: Job portal covering the full recruitment cycle: from candidate registration with AI-optimized profiles to final company selection with intelligent application analysis. Candidates receive job recommendations and can practice mock interviews. Companies manage job listings, search for candidates, evaluate applications with AI and compare applicants. Superadmin panel for global configuration, psychometric integration, multilingual support and per-company branding.
key_features: Complete candidate onboarding with enriched profile and AI optimization
AI-recommended jobs based on candidate profile
AI-simulated interviews for general and job-specific practice
Job posting and management with approval workflow
Selection pipeline management with AI analysis
AI evaluation of each application: strengths, gaps and match percentage
AI comparison between candidates for the same job
Advanced candidate search with subscription-controlled access
Superadmin panel: global catalogs, AI configuration and system policies
engineering_challenges: Multi-role architecture with distinct permissions and workflows per user type
Real-time commercial and operational quota control
Configurable AI per feature with editable prompts and usage limits
Multilingual support across the entire platform (ES/EN/PT)
Security and visibility control by plan on shared access
